status: frozen before the first recorded trial
question: Can a proposed change to a real VARE code path be accepted only when held-out tests pass, outputs are unchanged on fresh inputs, and a parent-measured speedup is statistically above 1.0?

target.note: hash-frozen for learning-pipeline run-001; candidates are applied only to a staged copy

measurement.seed: fresh 63-bit per rep, drawn by the parent, passed on sandbox stdin
measurement.primary_metric: parent perf_counter interval between receipt of the authenticated ready and done frames
measurement.secondary_metric: parent wall time of the whole sandbox process
measurement.cpu: parent and sandbox pinned to one CPU during measurement; runs strictly sequential

noise_floor.method: A/A: unmodified module against itself with the same schedule, once per session
noise_floor.valid_if: speedup 95% CI contains 1.0 and all runs ok

acceptance.rule: ACCEPT iff admitted AND policy clean AND static scan clean AND every public and held-out test PASSED (v2 frames) AND differential outputs equal AND every timed baseline/candidate output equals the parent expectation AND workload_covers_startup AND A/A valid AND speedup CI95 low > 1.0 AND speedup point >= 1.05; otherwise REJECT with the first failing reason
acceptance.audit_mode: runs with policy or static layers disabled are recorded but never accepted
